G3165.b:
⟪ἐγώ⟫, gen, etc., ἐμοῦ, ἐμοί, ἐμέ (enclitic μου, μοι, με), pl. ἡμεῖς, -ῶν, -ῖν, -ᾶς, pers. pron. ⟪I⟫.
⟪(a)⟫ The nom. is usually emphatic, when expressed as subjc, as in ⟦Matthew 3:11|Mt 3:11⟧, ⟦Mark 1:8|Mk 1:8⟧, ⟦Luke 3:16|Lk 3:16⟧, al. But often there is no apparent emphasis, as ⟦Matthew 10:16|Mt 10:16⟧, ⟦John 10:17|Jo 10:17⟧; ἰδοὺ ἐ. (= Heb. ⁨הִנֵּנִי⁩, cf. ⟦1 Samuel 3:8|I Ki 3:8⟧), ⟦Acts 9:10|Ac 9:10⟧; ἐ. (like Heb. ⁨אֲנִי⁩), ⟪I am⟫, ⟦John 1:23|Jo 1:23 (LXX)⟧, ⟦Acts 7:32|Ac 7:32 (LXX)⟧.
⟪(b)⟫ The enclitic forms (v. supr.) are used with nouns, adjectives, verbs, adverbs, where there is no emphasis: ἐν τ. πατρί μου, ⟦John 14:20|Jo 14:20⟧; μου τ. λόγους, ⟦Matthew 7:24|Mt 7:24⟧; ὀπίσω μου, ⟦Matthew 3:11|Mt 3:11⟧; ἰσχυρότερός μου, ⟦Matthew 3:11|ib.⟧; λέγει μοι, ⟦Revelation 5:5|Re 5:5⟧; also with the prep. πρός, as ⟦Mark 9:19|Mk 9:19⟧, al. The full forms (ἐμοῦ, etc.) are used with the other prepositions, as δι' ἐμοῦ, ἐν ἐμοί, εἰς ἐμέ, etc., also for emphasis, as ⟦Luke 10:16|Lk 10:16⟧, ⟦John 7:23|Jo 7:23⟧, ⟦Mark 14:7|Mk 14:7⟧, al.
⟪(c)⟫ The gen. μου and ἡμῶν are often used for the poss. pronouns ἐμός, ἡμέτερος: τ. λαόν μου, ⟦Matthew 2:6|Mt 2:6⟧; μου τῂ ἀπιστιᾳ, ⟦Mark 9:24|Mk 9:24⟧.
⟪(d)⟫ τί ἐμοὶ καὶ σοί ( = Heb. ⁨וָלָךְ מַה־לִי⁩, ⟦Judges 11:12|Jg 11:12⟧, al.), i.e. ⟪what have we in common⟫: ⟦Matthew 8:29|Mt 8:29⟧, ⟦Mark 1:24|Mk 1:24⟧ ⟦Mark 5:7|5:7⟧, ⟦Luke 8:28|Lk 8:28⟧, ⟦John 2:4|Jo 2:4⟧; τί γάρ μοι, ⟦1 Corinthians 5:2|I Co 5:2⟧.
⟪(e)⟫ The interchange of ἐγώ and ἡμεῖς, common in π., appears in Pauline Epp. (v. M, Pr., 86f., M, Th., 131f.).
⟪(f)⟫ κἀγώ (= καὶ ἐγώ, ⟪and I, even I, I also⟫: ⟦Matthew 2:8|Mt 2:8⟧, ⟦Luke 2:48|Lk 2:48⟧, ⟦John 6:56|Jo 6:56⟧, ⟦Romans 3:7|Ro 3:7⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 7:40|I Co 7:40⟧, al.; κἀγώ . . . καί, ⟪both . . . and⟫, ⟦John 7:28|Jo 7:28⟧.

(as in Att., but -αία, -αιον, ⟦1 Corinthians 15:17|I Co 15:17⟧, ⟦1 Peter 1:18|I Pe 1:18⟧; < μάτην), [in LXX for ⁨שָׁוְא⁩, ⁨הֶבֶל⁩, ⁨כָּזָב⁩, etc.;] ⟪vain⟫, ⟪useless⟫: ἀνωφελὴς κ. μ., ⟦Titus 3:9|Tit 3:9⟧; πίστις, ⟦1 Corinthians 15:17|I Co 15:17⟧; θρησκεία, ⟦James 1:26|Ja 1:26⟧; διαλογισμοί, ⟦1 Corinthians 3:20|I Co 3:20⟧(LXX); ἀναστροφή, ⟦1 Peter 1:18|I Pe 1:18⟧; of idols and heathen gods, τὰ μ. (⟦Jeremiah 2:5|Je 2:5⟧, ⟦2 Kings 17:15|IV Ki 17:15⟧, al.): ⟦Acts 14:15|Ac 14:15⟧.
SYN.: κενός, q.v.

G3153.b:
† ⟪ματαιότης⟫, -ητος, ἡ
(< μάταιος), [in LXX for ⁨הֶבֶל⁩, ⟦Psalms 31:6|Ps 30 (31):6⟧ ⟦Psalms 39:5|38 (39):5⟧ ⟦Psalms 62:9|61 (62):9⟧, al., and nearly 40 times in Ec; for ⁨שָׁוְא⁩, ⟦Psalms 25:4|Ps 25:4⟧, al.; ⁨רִיק⁩, etc.;] ⟪vanity⟫, ⟪emptiness⟫, ⟪frailty⟫, ⟪folly⟫: ⟦Romans 8:20|Ro 8:20⟧, ⟦2 Peter 2:18|II Pe 2:18⟧; τ. νοός, ⟦Ephesians 4:17|Eph 4:17⟧ (elsewhere only in Pollux, 6, 134, and Eccl.).†

G3154.b:
† ⟪ματαιόω⟫, -ῶ
(< μάταιος), [in LXX: ⟦2 Kings 17:15|IV Ki 17:15⟧, ⟦Jeremiah 2:5|Je 2:5⟧, al. ⁨הבל⁩, etc.;] ⟪to make vain⟫, ⟪foolish⟫: ⟦Romans 1:21|Ro 1:21⟧.†

G3155.b:
⟪μάτην⟫
(prop. acc. of μάτη, a fault, folly), adv.,
[in LXX for ⁨הֶבֶל⁩, ⁨שָׁוְא⁩, etc.;] ⟪in vain⟫, ⟪to no purpose⟫: ⟦Matthew 15:9|Mt 15:9⟧, ⟦Mark 7:7|Mk 7:7⟧(LXX).†

G3162.b:
⟪μάχαιρα⟫, -ης
(Att. -ας; v. WH, App., 156a; Bl., § 7, 1), ἡ, [in LXX chiefly for ⁨חֶרֶב⁩; also for ⁨מַאֲכֶלֶת⁩, etc.;]
⟪1.⟫ (in Hom., al.) ⟪a large knife⟫ or ⟪dirk⟫, for sacrificial purposes (⟦Genesis 22:6|Ge 22:6⟧, ⟦Genesis 22:10|10⟧, ⟦Judges 19:29|Jg 19:29⟧ A).
⟪2.⟫ ⟪a short sword⟫ or ⟪dagger⟫ (as disting. from ῥομφαία, a large broad sword and ξίφος, a straight sword for thrusting): ⟦Matthew 26:47|Mt 26:47⟧ ff., ⟦Mark 14:43|Mk 14:43⟧, ⟦Mark 14:47|47⟧, ⟦Mark 14:48|48⟧, ⟦Luke 22:36|Lk 22:36⟧ ff., ⟦John 18:10|Jo 18:10⟧, ⟦John 18:11|11⟧ ⟦Acts 16:27|Ac 16:27⟧, ⟦Hebrews 11:37|He 11:37⟧, ⟦Revelation 6:4|Re 6:4⟧ ⟦Revelation 13:10|13:10⟧, ⟦Revelation 13:14|14⟧; στόμα μαχαίρης (as in Heb. ⁨פִּה⁩ ⁨חֶרֶב⁩, ⟦Genesis 34:26|Ge 34:26⟧, al.), ⟪the edge of the sword⟫: ⟦Luke 21:24|Lk 21:24⟧, ⟦Hebrews 11:34|He 11:34⟧; μ. δίστομος, ⟦Hebrews 4:12|He 4:12⟧; ἀναιρεῖν μαχαίρῃ, ⟦Acts 12:2|Ac 12:2⟧; τὴν μ. φορεῖν, ⟦Romans 13:4|Ro 13:4⟧. Metaph., ⟦Matthew 10:34|Mt 10:34⟧ (opp. to εἰρήνη), ⟦Romans 8:35|Ro 8:35⟧; μ. τοῦ πνεύματος, ⟦Ephesians 6:17|Eph 6:17⟧.†
a: The N.T. in the original Greek, by B. F. Westcott and F. J. A. Hort. Vol. II, Introduction and Appendix. Macmillan, 1881

G3163.b:
⟪μάχη⟫, -ης, ἡ
(< μάχομαι), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨רִיב⁩;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪a fight⟫.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪a strife⟫, ⟪contention⟫, ⟪quarrel⟫: ⟦2 Corinthians 7:5|II Co 7:5⟧, ⟦2 Timothy 2:23|II Ti 2:23⟧, ⟦James 4:1|Ja 4:1⟧; pl., ⟦Titus 3:9|Tit 3:9⟧.†

G3164.b:
⟪μάχομαι⟫,
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨ריב⁩, also for ⁨נצה⁩ ni., etc.;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to⟫ ⟪fight⟫: ⟦Acts 7:26|Ac 7:26⟧.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪to quarrel⟫, ⟪dispute⟫: ⟦2 Timothy 2:24|II Ti 2:24⟧, ⟦James 4:2|Ja 4:2⟧; πρὸς ἀλλήλους, ⟦John 6:52|Jo 6:52⟧ (cf. δια-μάχομαι).†

G3166.b:
⟪μεγαλ-αυχέω⟫, -ῶ (= μεγάλα αὐχέω),
[in LXX: ⟦Ezekiel 16:50|Ez 16:50⟧ (⁨גּבהּ⁩), al.;] ⟪to boast great things⟫: ⟦James 3:5|Ja 3:5⟧ (Rec. for μεγάλα αὐχεῖ, WH).†
a: The N.T. in the original Greek, by B. F. Westcott and F. J. A. Hort. Vol. II, Introduction and Appendix. Macmillan, 1881

G3167.b:
⟪μεγαλεῖος⟫, -εία, -εῖον
(< μέγας), [in LXX: ⟦Psalms 71:19|Ps 70 (71):19⟧ (⁨גָּדוֹל⁩), al., freq. in Sir;] ⟪magnificent⟫, ⟪splendid⟫ (Xen., Plut., al.): ⟦Acts 2:11|Ac 2:11⟧.†

G3168.b:
⟪μεγαλειότης⟫, -ητος, ἡ
(< μεγαλεῖος), [in LXX: ⟦Jeremiah 33:9|Je 40 (33):9⟧ (⁨תִּפְאֶרֶת⁩), ⟦Daniel 7:27|Da LXX 7:27⟧, I Es 1:5 4:40*;] ⟪splendour⟫, ⟪magnificence⟫: ⟦Luke 9:43|Lk 9:43⟧, ⟦Acts 19:27|Ac 19:27⟧, ⟦2 Peter 1:16|II Pe 1:16⟧ (freq. in π. as a ceremonial title, MM, xvi).†

G3169.b:
⟪μεγαλοπρεπής⟫, ές (= μεγάλῳ πρέπων),
[in LXX: ⟦Deuteronomy 33:26|De 33:26⟧ (⁨גַּאֲוָה⁩), II Mac 8:15 15:13, III Mac 2:9*;] ⟪befitting a great man⟫, ⟪magnificent⟫, ⟪majestic⟫: ⟦2 Peter 1:17|II Pe 1:17⟧ (cf. MM, xvi).†

G3170.b:
⟪μεγαλύνω⟫
(< μέγας), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨גּדל⁩ pi., hi.;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to make great⟫: ⟦Matthew 23:5|Mt 23:5⟧, ⟦Luke 1:58|Lk 1:58⟧.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪to declare great⟫, ⟪extol⟫, ⟪magnify⟫: ⟦Luke 1:46|Lk 1:46⟧, ⟦Acts 5:13|Ac 5:13⟧ ⟦Acts 10:46|10:46⟧ ⟦Acts 19:17|19:17⟧, ⟦2 Corinthians 10:15|II Co 10:15⟧; pass., seq. ἐν, ⟦Philippians 1:20|Phl 1:20⟧.†

G3172.b:
† ⟪μεγαλωσύνη⟫, -ης, ἡ
(< μέγας), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨גְּדוּלָה⁩ and cogn. forms, ⟦2 Samuel 7:23|II Ki 7:23⟧, ⟦Psalms 145:3|Ps 144 (145):3⟧, al.;] ⟪greatness⟫, ⟪majesty⟫: ⟦Hebrews 1:3|He 1:3⟧ ⟦Hebrews 8:1|8:1⟧, ⟦Jude 1:25|Ju 25⟧ (elsewhere Eccl. only).†

a: The Words of Jesus, by G. Dalman. English Edition. T. & T. Clark, 1902
Bible Studies, by G. A. Deissmann. Second English Edition, including Bibelstudien and Neue Bibelstudien, tr. by A. Grieve. T. & T. Clark, 1909
Notes on the Translation of the N.T., by F. Field, Camb., 1899
A Grammar of N.T. Greek. Vol. I, Prolegomena, by J. H. Moulton. Third Edition. Scribners, 1908

G3174.b:
⟪μέγεθος⟫, -ους, τό
(< μέγας), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨קוֹמָה⁩;] ⟪greatness⟫: ⟦Ephesians 1:19|Eph 1:19⟧ (cf. MM, xvi, s.v. μέγας).†

G3175.b:
† ⟪μεγιστάν⟫, -ᾶνος, ὁ
(< μέγιστος), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨שַׂר⁩, ⟦Jeremiah 24:8|Je 24:8⟧, al.; ⁨רַבְרְבָן⁩, ⟦Daniel 5:23|Da LXX TH 5:23⟧, al.; freq. in Sir (sing., Si 4:7);] usually pl., οἱ μ., ⟪the chief men⟫, ⟪nobles⟫ (Manetho, FlJ, al.): ⟦Mark 6:21|Mk 6:21⟧, ⟦Revelation 6:15|Re 6:15⟧ ⟦Revelation 18:23|18:23⟧.†

G3178.b:
⟪μέθη⟫, -ης, ἡ,
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨שֵׁכָר⁩ and cognate forms;] ⟪drunkenness⟫: ⟦Luke 21:34|Lk 21:34⟧; pl., ⟦Romans 13:13|Ro 13:13⟧, ⟦Galatians 5:21|Ga 5:21⟧.†
SYN.: v.s. κῶμος.

G3179.b:
⟪μεθ-ίστημι⟫ and (late form, ⟦1 Corinthians 13:2|I Co 13:2⟧) μεθιστάνω,
[in LXX for ⁨סור⁩ hi., etc.;] trans. in pres., impf., fut. and aor.
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to change⟫, ⟪remove⟫: c. acc. rei, ὄρη, ⟦1 Corinthians 13:2|I Co 13:2⟧ (cf. ⟦Isaiah 54:10|Is 54:10⟧); c. acc. pers.: seq. εἰς, ⟦Colossians 1:13|Col 1:13⟧; seq. ἐκ, pass., ⟦Luke 16:4|Lk 16:4⟧; of causing death (cf. similar intrans. sense, Eur., Alc., 21, al.), ⟦Acts 13:22|Ac 13:22⟧. Metaph. (cf. τ. καρδίαν μ., ⟦Joshua 14:8|Jos 14:8⟧), c. acc. pers., ⟪to pervert⟫: ⟦Acts 19:26|Ac 19:26⟧.†

G3180.b:
*† ⟪μεθ-οδία⟫ (Rec. -εία; cf. Bl., § 3, 5), -ας, ἡ
(< † μεθοδεύω, 1. to treat by rule. 2. to employ craft: ⟦2 Kings 19:27|IV Ki 19:27⟧*) ⟪craft⟫, ⟪deceit⟫: ⟦Ephesians 4:14|Eph 4:14⟧ ⟦Ephesians 6:11|6:11⟧ (not found elsewhere; v. AR, in l.).†
a: St. Paul's Epistle to the Ephesians, by J. Armitage Robinson. Second Edition. Macmillan, 1909

G3181.b:
⟪μεθ-όριον⟫, -ου, τό
(neut. of μεθόριος, -α, -ον), [in LXX: ⟦Joshua 19:27|Jos 19:27⟧ A*;] Rec. for ὅριον (q.v.), ⟪a border⟫, ⟪boundary⟫: ⟦Mark 7:24|Mk 7:24⟧.†

G3182.b:
⟪μεθύσκω⟫,
[in LXX: ⟦Psalms 23:5|Ps 22 (23):5⟧ (⁨רוה⁩), ⟦Proverbs 4:17|Pr 4:17⟧ (⁨שׁתה⁩), etc.;] causal of μεθύω, ⟪to make drunk⟫, ⟪intoxicate⟫; pass., ⟪to get drunk⟫: ⟦Luke 12:45|Lk 12:45⟧, ⟦Ephesians 5:18|Eph 5:18⟧, ⟦1 Thessalonians 5:7|I Th 5:7⟧.†

G3183.b:
⟪μέθυσος⟫, -α, -ον
(also -ος, -ον; prop., only of women, but in late writers also = μεθυστικός, of men), [in LXX: ⟦Proverbs 23:21|Pr 23:21⟧ (⁨סבא⁩) ⟦Proverbs 26:9|26:9⟧ (⁨שִׁכּוֹר⁩), Si 19:1 26:8, IV Mac 2:7*;] ⟪drunken⟫: ⟦1 Corinthians 5:11|I Co 5:11⟧ ⟦1 Corinthians 6:10|6:10⟧.†

G3184.b:
⟪μεθύω⟫
(< μέθυ, wine, cf. μέθη), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨שׁכר⁩, ⁨רוה⁩;] ⟪to be drunken⟫: ⟦Matthew 24:49|Mt 24:49⟧, ⟦John 2:10|Jo 2:10⟧, ⟦Acts 2:15|Ac 2:15⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 11:21|I Co 11:21⟧, ⟦1 Thessalonians 5:7|I Th 5:7⟧; metaph., ⟦Revelation 17:2|Re 17:2⟧, ⟦Revelation 17:6|6⟧.†

G3189.b:
⟪μέλας⟫, -αινα, -αν, gen., -ανος, -αίνης, -ανος,
[in LXX: ⟦Song of Solomon 1:5|Ca 1:5⟧, ⟦Zechariah 6:2|Za 6:2⟧ (⁨שָׁחֹר⁩), etc.;] ⟪black⟫: ⟦Revelation 6:5|Re 6:5⟧, ⟦Revelation 6:12|12⟧; opp. to λευκός, ⟦Matthew 5:36|Mt 5:36⟧; neut., τὸ μ., ⟪ink⟫ : ⟦2 Corinthians 3:3|II Co 3:3⟧, ⟦2 John 1:12|II Jo 12⟧, ⟦3 John 1:13|III Jo 13⟧.†

G3191.b:
⟪μελετάω⟫, -ῶ
(< μελέτη, care), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨הגה⁩;]
⟪1.⟫ c. gen., ⟪to care for⟫ (Hes.).
⟪2.⟫ C. acc. ⟪to attend to⟫, ⟪practise⟫: ⟦1 Timothy 4:15|I Ti 4:15⟧ (RV, be diligent in; cf. Souter in Exp., VIII, vi, 429, but v. infr.).
⟪3.⟫ ⟪to study⟫, ⟪ponder⟫: ⟦Acts 4:25|Ac 4:25⟧(LXX), ⟦1 Timothy 4:15|I Ti 4:15⟧ (AV, meditate on; cf. CGT, in l., but v. supr.; cf. προ-μελετάω).†
a: Cambridge Greek Testament for Schools and Colleges

G3192.b:
⟪μέλι⟫, -τος, τό,
[in LXX freq. (⟦Genesis 43:11|Ge 43:11⟧, al.) for ⁨דְּבַשׁ⁩; for ⁨נֹפֶת⁩, ⟦Proverbs 5:3|Pr 5:3⟧;] ⟪honey⟫: ⟦Revelation 10:9|Re 10:9⟧, ⟦Revelation 10:10|10⟧; ἄγριον (q.v.), ⟦Matthew 3:4|Mt 3:4⟧, ⟦Mark 1:9|Mk 1:9⟧.†

G3193.b:
*† ⟪μελίσσιος⟫, -α, -ον
(elsewhere † -αῖος, -ειος; < μέλισσα, a bee, cf. μέλι), ⟪made by bees⟫: ⟦Luke 24:42|Lk 24:42⟧ (Rec., WH, R, mg.).†
a: The N.T. in the original Greek, by B. F. Westcott and F. J. A. Hort. Vol. II, Introduction and Appendix. Macmillan, 1881

G3194.b: ⟪Μελίτη⟫, (Rec., R, txt.), Μελιτήνη (WH, R, mg., v. WH, App., 160), ⟪Melita⟫, ⟪Melitene⟫ (mod. Malta): ⟦Acts 28:1|Ac 28:1⟧.†
a: The N.T. in the original Greek, by B. F. Westcott and F. J. A. Hort. Vol. II, Introduction and Appendix. Macmillan, 1881
Notes on the Translation of the N.T., by F. Field, Camb., 1899

G3196.b:
⟪μέλος⟫, -ους, τό,
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨נֵתַח⁩;] ⟪a member⟫, ⟪limb⟫ of the body: ⟦1 Corinthians 12:14|I Co 12:14⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 12:19|19⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 12:26|26⟧, ⟦Ephesians 4:16|Eph 4:16⟧ (WH, mg.), ⟦James 3:5|Ja 3:5⟧; pl. (as always in cl.), τὰ μ.: ⟦Matthew 5:29|Mt 5:29⟧, ⟦Matthew 5:30|30⟧, ⟦Romans 6:13|Ro 6:13⟧, ⟦Romans 6:19|19⟧ ⟦Romans 7:5|7:5⟧, ⟦Romans 7:23|23⟧ ⟦Romans 12:4|12:4⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 12:12|I Co 12:12⟧ ff. ⟦Colossians 3:5|Col 3:5⟧, ⟦James 3:6|Ja 3:6⟧ ⟦James 4:1|4:1⟧. Metaph., πόρνης, ⟦1 Corinthians 6:15|I Co 6:15⟧; of Christians, μ. ἀλλήλων, ⟦Romans 12:5|Ro 12:5⟧, ⟦Ephesians 4:25|Eph 4:25⟧; Χριστοῦ, ⟦1 Corinthians 6:15|I Co 6:15⟧; σώματος Χριστοῦ, ⟦1 Corinthians 12:27|I Co 12:27⟧, ⟦Ephesians 5:30|Eph 5:30⟧.†
a: The N.T. in the original Greek, by B. F. Westcott and F. J. A. Hort. Vol. II, Introduction and Appendix. Macmillan, 1881

G3199.b:
⟪μέλω⟫,
[in LXX: ⟦Job 22:3|Jb 22:3⟧ (⁨חֵפֶץ⁩), To 10:5, Wi 12:13, I Mac 14:42, 43*;]
⟪1.⟫ intrans., ⟪to be an object of care⟫, ⟪be a care⟫; commonly in third pers.: c. dat. pers., ⟦Acts 18:17|Ac 18:17⟧; very freq. impers., ⟦1 Corinthians 7:21|I Co 7:21⟧; seq. ὅτι, ⟦Mark 4:38|Mk 4:38⟧, ⟦Luke 10:40|Lk 10:40⟧; c. gen. rei (as freq. in Att.), ⟦1 Corinthians 9:9|I Co 9:9⟧; seq. περί, ⟦Matthew 22:16|Mt 22:16⟧, ⟦Mark 12:14|Mk 12:14⟧, ⟦John 10:13|Jo 10:13⟧ ⟦John 12:6|12:6⟧, ⟦1 Peter 5:7|I Pe 5:7⟧.
⟪2.⟫ Trans., in act. and mid., ⟪to care for⟫ (not in LXX or NT).†
